name: INFERLAB_AUTH_ORIGIN
label: InferLab origin
help: The origin of the InferLab central-auth deployment people connect through, for example https://auth.inferops.io. It also serves the InferOps API the connection reads. InferLab operations is a public client: there is no client secret.
setupSteps: In InferOps, register this deployment's origin for the inferos client (auth.sso.inferosOrigins) and name its company (auth.sso.inferosCompanies).
InferOps accepts the redirect URI below exactly.

name: INFEROPS_COMPANY
label: InferOps company (tenant id)
help: The tenant id of the one company this deployment serves. A connection from any other company is refused.
